## About

I'm Toby Tebbs, a mathematics student at Southern Utah University interested in quantitative research, statistical modeling, and computational data analysis.

This portfolio collects selected work from **MATH 3190: Fundamentals of Data Science**. The assignments below are presented as coursework, with the original problem statements, code, analysis, and results preserved. They cover statistical inference, numerical methods, regression, dimensionality reduction, Bayesian methods, machine learning, and time-series forecasting.

::: {.callout-note}
### For a quick overview
The strongest quantitative examples are **Numerical Methods & Optimization**, **Statistical Inference & Regression**, **Regularization & Generalized Linear Models**, **Bayesian Inference & MCMC**, and **Time-Series Analysis & Forecasting**.
:::

## Coursework Archive

The [coursework archive](coursework.qmd) contains the complete collection, including **Homework 1** and the full original assignment structure. The selected work above is simply the portion most relevant to quantitative and data-science applications.

## Tools & Methods

**Languages:** R, Python  
**Methods:** statistical inference, regression, regularization, Bayesian inference, MCMC, numerical optimization, PCA/PLS, classification, time-series analysis  
**Libraries/tools used across the coursework:** tidyverse, caret, glmnet, pls, Quarto, and related statistical computing tools
